boundaries.policy: Criticality is jurisdiction-, method-, and time-specific. This U.S. list is not a universal geological definition.
boundaries.rareEarths: The list has 15 explicitly denoted rare-earth elements. Scandium remains a critical mineral here but is not counted among those 15 list markers.
boundaries.forms: Mineral commodities, elements, oxides, concentrates, metals, and baskets are not silently treated as interchangeable.

methodology.comparisons: Only same-series changes are calculated. Unlike commodity units and product forms are never ranked by raw price.
methodology.concentration: A top-producer share is derived only from a named-country value and compatible World total in the same USGS table and form.
methodology.chain: Addresses are not people; bounded transfers are not trades; verified proxy lineage is capability context, not evidence that a capability was invoked.
methodology.productClaims: Metals.io claims are attributed. This artifact does not independently attest backing, beneficial ownership, custody, insurance, price, liquidity, or redemption.
methodology.execution: This Chamber is read-only and intentionally provides no buy, sell, swap, bridge, redeem, order, or wallet action.
